description: Core dev/test tier — the minimal baseline (core.boot.json) plus grid_fixtures, and nothing else. grid_fixtures is the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the CORE test suites (tap_grid, tap_web, tap_auth, tap_api, tap_cares, ...) build their fixtures from; installing just it is enough to run the core tier without dragging in any domain plugin. Sibling of the gryphon profile, which adds gryphon_playground on top of the same core+grid_fixtures floor for the Gryphon suites. Reaches out to nothing; grid_fixtures carries no GRIFT seed so population is empty. NOT for running plugin tests — each plugin's suite needs that plugin installed, via its own per-plugin profile. Named `core_dev` (not `dev_core`) so it sorts/reads right next to `core`: the base concept leads, the qualifier trails.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.grid_fixtures). Install-only: the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the core test suites build fixtures from. No GRIFT seed, no cross-plugin deps. The only thing above the core baseline in this tier.
